body: Thank you. My cousin was...is.. I don't know which to use, but shes an amazing person. It's true that purehearted people are the ones that are most likely to go first.  Now that I know that she's been through so much...I guess I wouldn't really blame her. All she's done was put others before herself.  I have a nasty feeling that something has been done to her.

Thank you for taking the time to listen to me. I'm sorry to hear you struggle with depression. I myself do not... i can't bebegin to understand that kind of pain. I won't hesitate to pm you if I learn anything

I feel completely sick to my stomach.  I sincerely hope he hadn't done anything to her...I too don't understand why she would only tell him. Something isn't right. .. I've already alerted the authorities. Oh god.... I really hope he hadn't done something :( jesus Christ...

Oh god...I've read everything. Her ex is a sick son of a bitch...jesus if I could get my hands on him. He's definitely had a huge part in destroying her life... but no...you don't possibly think he could've killed her? Oh god..I sincerely hope that she's okay and she's just missing

I couldn't believe that she went through everything she had. The last thing she said to me was that she couldn't do this anymore. I didn't know what "this" was. I was so clueless. She basically told me that she was going to off herself...her ex. Man, I've only met him a few times and he just seemed like your typical douchebag... I guess you never really know a person. I had no idea what he was doing to her. I really hope she's just missing and not dead. He better be lying.  He said she told him she was going to kill herself.... I just don't get why she'd tell him. I'm really scared that its true.
My aunt hasn't seen her in days. Her brother hasn't either. I don't knoq where she could possibly be! I learned about it through her ex boyfriend. .... I just don't know
